newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder March oper revs down.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder March oper revs down.

text.p: Knight-Ridder Inc said Wednesday that March operating revenue fell to $218.9 million from $227.31 million for the same period in the prior month.
The company said total March newspaper revenue was $192.02 million compared to $184.18 million in March 1996.
Knight-Ridder said its newspapers in Detroit, Philadelphia and Charlotte had a strong month, while San Jose was soft.
Business information services revenue fell to $26.87 million from $43.13 million in March 1996.

Total newspaper division operating revenue was up 4.3 percent for the month and 5.3 percent for the year to date. Total advertising revenue was up 5.9 percent for the month on a full-run linage increase of 5.5 percent.
Retail advertising was up 6.7 percent for the month on a full-run linage increase of 5.7 percent. Year-to-date, retail advertising was up 6.2 percent.
Classified was up 4.7 percent for the month on a full-run linage increase of 5.7 percent.
